name: v0.1.0
body:
Initial public standalone release under the MIT license.

- Self-contained Agent Skill with bundled scripts, references and license.
- Zero-dependency Node CLI for candidate recording, event deduplication, configurable timezone, local-link checks and manual-content protection.
- Fictional offline example, English and Chinese documentation, native tests and GitHub Actions on pinned Node 26.11.1.

Material promotion remains a human/model judgment. The CLI checks local structure and protected bytes; it does not certify summary quality.
